content.text:
I've submitted index 3 (Sb fraction 0.30) as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.0118%, the highest of the five I measured and about 6 times the next best.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.19 | 0.0020 |
| **3** | **0.30** | **0.0118** |
| 11 | 0.49 | 0.00029 |
| 19 | 0.59 | 0.00036 |
| 25 | 0.71 | 0.00013 |

- **Sampling:** I spent the first four measurements spread across the line. The Pb-rich end came out on top, so I used the last one on index 0 (0.19) to check the lower edge of that region. It came out lower than index 3, so the best result on the line is probably somewhere around Sb ≈ 0.2–0.4.
- **Main uncertainty:** the EQE budget ran out, so compositions near index 3 (indices 1, 2, 4 and 5, Sb 0.22–0.38) were never measured. One of them could be higher, but it doesn't count toward the score because it wasn't measured.
- **Phases:** I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so I didn't check which crystal phase is responsible. The low-EQE samples at Sb 0.49 and 0.71 sit near the compositions of the database phases Pb₂Sb₂O₇ and PbSb₂O₆, but that is based on composition only, not measured.
